requirements.missing: No supplied document describes a specific grower decision rule for determining last-irrigation timing before harvest (e.g., measured soil-moisture threshold, ET-based calculation, days-before-cut heuristic, or growth-stage trigger). s10 and s11 discuss deficit-irrigation strategies and partial-season termination in general terms but do not present a concrete last-irrigation timing rule.

s10 reports irrigation reductions as 25% and 50% of total season rate (e.g., 13.5 inches full rate at Logan, UT) but does not specify a last-termination rule with explicit units. s12 gives evapotranspiration rates (0.30 in/day growing season, 0.10 in/day fall) and a six-week pre-frost interval for the last cutting, but does not tie a measurable soil-water or ET threshold to the final-irrigation decision. Missing: volumetric water per event, allowable depletion fraction, days-before-cut numeric rule, or explicit differentiation of applied water from crop water use tied to last-irrigation timing.
